summary: Akamai Technologies filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, reporting entry into Amendment No. 3 to its credit agreement and announcing a private offering of $1.3 billion each of Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 and 2032. The amendment temporarily increases the maximum consolidated leverage ratio covenant to 4.75:1.00 for fiscal quarters ending June 30 and September 30, 2026, providing financial flexibility for the concurrent note offering. The offering is to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. This debt issuance is not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring but a capital markets transaction. Watch for market reception of the convertible notes and potential dilution from conversion.
